name: Durlag the Kingsbane
bio: Durlag the Kingsbane leads the famously-mad Voidstormers. He has spent his life raiding the Voidscar, taking out Demons and bringing home artifacts. It has left him respected, reviled and… number 1 on the Demons' most-wanted list.
